fix(dataflow): isolate quality tests after dev synchronization

Rebase this Dataflow slice onto dev cdfe8e2b after the reviewed Sequence diagnostic merged. Preserve the Sequence self-message note and Lifecycle v3 while combining the authoring-defaults conflict; rebuild the archive from combined source instead of choosing either old ZIP.

CodeRabbit identified an unconditional Dataflow authoring hint and render-test subprocesses that inherited the host quality profile despite inspect() isolating validation. Link the canonical Dataflow contract and pass inspect.env to every direct render call, keeping explicit environment and CLI precedence cases intact.

The inherited Standard reproduction failed four of five selected cases before this fix; inherited Showcase failed one. Both full Dataflow runs now pass 37/37, with zero skips. Combined-source focused tests pass 39/39, golden, validator and Gallery checks pass, and independent integration/bot-fix review is ready. Runtime Dataflow/Architecture/shared renderer source remains byte-identical to reviewed b1b32dff.

Official Node 22.23.2 and bundled zlib 1.3.1-e00f703 produce two byte-identical ZIPs, SHA256 38b1b4389dc62bc34e9c377829335e8d83bd42979424174dbbb63f189c124b7c. Final exact-head remote CI remains required.
